title: Independent review of WD-001 (weight-decay check: phase-B ImageNetV2 results, analysis and report)
description: Review follows the submit-then-independent-review protocol. Phase A's selection lock was already reviewed (WD-001S, REVIEW-013); do not redo it beyond confirming selected.json is unchanged. Check: (1) analyze.py implements WD-001 task.json's confirmatory family exactly (W1-W4 pooled over source/L080/L090 as per-seed mean of per-level differences, paired by seed 45-51, df 6, t 2.447, Holm over 4, meaningful at 1.0 and 0.5 pp) and loads the right RETEST-001 comparison runs (dense-M2048 and sparse-M2048 at lr 1e-4, linear at lr 3e-4, phase 'retest'); (2) independently recompute W1-W4, the per-level differences and the compression costs from runs/WD-001/results.csv and runs/RETEST-001/results.csv without importing analyze.py; (3) phase-B checks: 42 runs, settings equal selected.json, split digests equal SEED-001, wd groups, selected epochs, no duplicate test rows; (4) the overnight interruption and resume (runs/WD-001/test_log.txt; the deleted partial run sparse-CE L090 seed49 was re-run; no stale rows); (5) report.md: every number against analysis.md/json and your recomputation; whether the reading of W1 (detected negative but below tolerance, outside the pre-declared readings) and W2 (meaningful) is stated without overclaiming; the caveats (sparse-CE lr edge / budget binds, dense tie-break, tuning asymmetry, coupled L2, scope, test reuse); exploratory parts labeled; timeline. Read-only outside this folder; no training or GPU. Record a verdict on WD-001.
acceptance: Verdict on WD-001 recorded with a note citing the checks
